using namespace std;

#define rep(i,a,b) for(int i = a; i != b; i++)
typedef long long ll;
const int N = 8105; // Change this to make it larger if you need to handle larger inputs
int mod = 1e9 + 7;

ll dp[N][N * N + 5];
ll sums[N][N * N + 5];

template <class T> inline void read (T& x) {
	x=0; char c=getchar();
	while (!isdigit(c)) c=getchar();
	while (isdigit(c)) { x=x*10+c-'0'; c=getchar(); }
}

int main()
{
	read(mod);
	int n = 8105;
	ll INF = 998244353;	// This represents INFINITY in most cases

	// Initialize dp and sums
	rep(i, 0, n){
		rep(j, 0, n * N + 5)
			dp[i][j] = 0;

		rep(j, 0, n * N + 5)
			sums[i][j] = 0;
	}
	sums[0][0] = 1; // Hardcoded value to get rid of the / by 0 division

	rep(i, 2, 8105) {
		sums[i][i] = 1;
		for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
			sums[i][j] = (sums[i - 1][j] + sums[i - 1][j + 1]) % mod;
	}

	// Special case to initialize 1st row of dp.
	for (int i = 0; i < 8105; i++)
		for (int j = 0; j < 8105; j++)
			if (i - j >= 0)
				dp[i][j] = (dp[i - 1][j] + dp[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;

	rep(i, 1, 8105) {
		for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
			for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
				if (j - k >= 0)
					dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - k];
				dp[i][j] %= mod;
				if (dp[i][j] == 0) {
					dp[i][j] += mod;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Special case to initialize 1st col of sums
	ll fact[8105];

	for (int i = 0; i < 8105; i++)
		fact[i] = 1;

	int index = 2;
	for (int i = 2; i <= 8105; i++) {
		fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
		if (!fact[i])fact[i] += mod;
	}

	ll ncr[8105][8105];

	for (int i = 0; i < 8105; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < 8105; j++) {
			ncr[i][j] = 0;
		}
	}

	for (int i = 0; i < 8105; i++) {
		ncr[i][0] = 1;
	}

	for (int L = 2; L <= 8105; ++L) {
		for (int R = 1; R <= 8105; ++R) {
			ncr[L][R] = (ncr[L - 1][R - 1] + ncr[L - 1][R]) % mod;

			if (ncr[L][R] == 0)ncr[L][R] += mod;
		}
	}

	ll res = 0;

	for (int i = 0; i <= 8104 - 2; i++) {
		int cnt = 8104 - i;

		int pre = 8104 - cnt;

		ll com = (ncr[8104][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;

		if (!com) com += mod;

		int R = 2;

		for (int j = 2; R <= 8105 && R <= cnt + 2; R++) { // j == inversions

			res += dp[cnt - 2][R] * (ncr[8104][8104 - R] * fact[8104 - R]) % mod * (8104 - 1);

			res %= mod;

			if (!res) res += mod;
			ll cntcnt = 0;
			ll cntsum = 0;

			if (R - cnt - 1 >= 0) {
				cntsum += sums[cnt - 2][R - cnt - 1];
				if (!cntsum) cntsum += mod;
			}
			else cntsum += mod;
			if (!cntsum) cntsum += mod;
			cntsum %= mod;
			ll aaaa = sums[cnt - 2][R - 2];

			if (R - cnt - 1 >= 0)
				aaaa -= sums[cnt - 2][R - cnt - 1];
			if (!aaaa) aaaa += mod;
			if (!aaaa) aaaa += mod;
			aaaa%=mod;

			ll acnt = (cnt - 1 - aaaa);
			if (!acnt) acnt += mod;
			acnt = (cnt - acnt-1);
			if (!acnt) acnt += mod;
			if (!acnt) acnt += mod;
			acnt%=mod;

			ll baaa = dp[cnt - 2][R - 2];

			if (!baaa) baaa += mod;
			if (!baaa) baaa += mod;

			res += baaa * acnt;
			res %= mod;
			if (!res) res += mod;

			ll bsum = sums[cnt - 2][R - 2];

			if (R - cnt - 1 >= 0) {
				bsum -= sums[cnt - 2][R - cnt - 1];
			}
			if (!bsum) bsum += mod;
			bsum%=mod;

			ll cccc = bsum + aaaa;
			if (!cccc) cccc+=mod;
			if (R - cnt - 1 >= 0)
				cccc += sums[cnt - 2][R - cnt - 1];
			if (!cccc) cccc += mod;
			cccc %= mod;

			res -= cccc;
			res %= mod;
			if (!res) res += mod;

		}
	}
	// change this value if you want to handle larger inputs
	out:
	for (int i = 0; i < 8105; i++)
		for (int j = 0; j < 8105 * 8105 + 5; j++)
			dp[i][j] = 0;
	cout << res << endl;
}
